name: Abbadomon
look: a floating vortex of black ribbons round an empty core, every ribbon studded with staring red eyes, a purple glow and a fanged maw at its heart
entry: A shape of black ribbons wound round an empty core and covered in staring red eyes. It is said to be made of everything that was ever deleted, and it pulls the light out of any world it drifts into.
how: Evolves into Abbadomon Core at level 60.
